source_text: Τί οὖν; Πρῶτα μὲν αἱ τῆς ψυχῆς ἄλογοι καὶ ἰνδαλματώδεις περὶ τὰς δόξας κινήσεις ἄλλοτε ἄλλα εἴδωλα, τὰ μὲν ἀπὸ τῆς ὕλης ἕλκουσι, τὰ δὲ αὐταῖς ἀναπλάττουσι καὶ κυοῦσι· πάσχει δὲ τοῦτο ψυχὴ μάλιστα τοῦ ὑλικοῦ προσλαβοῦσα καὶ ἐπισυγκραθεῖσα πνεύματος, οὐ πρὸς τὰ οὐράνια καὶ τὸν τούτων ποιητὴν ἀλλὰ κάτω πρὸς τὰ ἐπίγεια βλέπουσα, καθολικῶς εἰς γῆν, ὡς μόνον αἷμα καὶ σάρξ, οὐκέτι πνεῦμα καθαρὸν γινομένη. Αἷ οὖν ἄλογοι αὗται καὶ ἰνδαλματώδεις τῆς ψυχῆς κινήσεις εἰδωλομανεῖς ἀποτίκτουσι φαντασίας. Ὅταν δὲ ἁπαλὴ καὶ εὐάγωγος ψυχή, ἀνήκοος μὲν καὶ ἄπειρος λόγων ἐῤῥωμένων, ἀθεώρητος δὲ τοῦ ἀληθοῦς, ἀπερινόητος δὲ τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ ποιητοῦ τῶν ὅλων, ἐναποσφραγίσηται ψευδεῖς περὶ αὐτῆς δόξας, οἱ περὶ τὴν ὕλην δαίμονες, λίχνοι περὶ τὰς κνίσσας καὶ τὸ τῶν ἱερείων αἷμα ὄντες, ἀπατηλοὶ δὲ ἀνθρώπων, προσλαβόντες τὰς ψευδοδόξους ταύτας τῶν πολλῶν τῆς ψυχῆς κινήσεις, φαντασίας αὐτοῖς ὡς ἀπὸ τῶν εἰδώλων καὶ ἀγαλμάτων, ἐπιβατεύοντες αὐτῶν τοῖς νοήμασιν, εἰσρεῖν παρέχουσι· καὶ ὅσα καθ᾿ ἑαυτήν, ὡς ἀθάνατος οὖσα, λογικῶς κινεῖται ψυχή, ἢ προμηνύουσα τὰ μέλλοντα ἢ θεραπεύουσα τὰ ἐνεστηκότα, τούτων τὴν δόξαν καρποῦνται οἱ δαίμονες.
pass_a_gloss: What then? First, the irrational and idol-like movements of the soul concerning the opinions, at one time different images, some of which it draws from matter, and others it forms and conceives for itself; and the soul suffers this especially when it has taken on and is mixed with the material spirit, not looking towards the heavenly things and their maker, but downwards towards the earthly things, universally towards the earth, as if it were only blood and flesh, no longer pure spirit. And these irrational and idol-like movements of the soul produce idolatrous fancies. When, however, a tender and easily influenced soul, unable to hear and unexperienced in spoken words, unobserved by the truth, and unperceiving of the Father and maker of all things, is sealed with false opinions about itself, the demons around the matter, being like lamps around the altars and the blood of the sacrifices, and being deceivers of men, having taken on these false opinions, the many movements of the soul, produce for them fancies as if from idols and statues, and by stepping on their thoughts, they provide an entrance; and all the things that the soul moves logically by itself, as being immortal, either foretelling the future or serving the present needs, the demons reap the benefit of these things.

pass_b_english: What then? First, the irrational, idol-like movements of the soul concerning its opinions shift from one image to another: some it draws from matter, others it forms and conceives for itself. The soul suffers this most especially when it has taken on and been compounded with the material spirit, looking not toward the heavenly things and their Maker but downward toward the earthly things, universally toward the earth, as if it were only blood and flesh, no longer becoming pure spirit. These irrational, idol-like movements of the soul give birth to idolatrous fancies.

But when a tender and easily led soul—deaf to and unskilled in strong words, unobserved by the Truth, and failing to perceive the Father and Maker of all—is sealed with false opinions about itself, the demons who hover around matter (like lamps around the altars and the blood of sacrifices) and who deceive men, take up these false-opinion-driven movements of the soul; they produce fancies for them as if coming from idols and statues, and by stepping upon their thoughts they provide an entrance. And whatever the soul, as immortal, moves rationally within itself—whether foretelling the future or serving present needs—the demons reap the glory of these things.

review.notes: The translation accurately captures the complex Greek syntax regarding the soul's movements and the demons' exploitation of them. Pass B correctly renders 'εἰδωλομανεῖς ἀποτίκτουσι φαντασίας' as 'give birth to idolatrous fancies' and 'καρποῦνται' as 'reap the glory' (or benefit), maintaining the agency of the demons. The distinction between the soul's rational movement and the demons' interference is preserved.
